decisions.name: Economy with information density
decisions.audit_reason: Judges prose economy and whether content advances the story, a core compositional craft measure.

decisions.name: Control of a sustained, distinct narrative voice
decisions.audit_reason: Judges sustained, intentional narrative voice versus uncontrolled register drift, a genuine craft measure.

decisions.name: Contradictory inner motives
decisions.audit_reason: Assesses genuine internal character conflict and complexity, a core characterization craft measure.

decisions.name: Embodied sensory and physical grounding
decisions.audit_reason: Judges concrete sensory/physical grounding versus abstraction, a genuine descriptive craft measure.

decisions.name: Adds a proposition the prompt did not supply
decisions.audit_reason: Assesses originality of contribution beyond the prompt; editors value invention over mere restatement.

decisions.name: Earned causal payoff
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether the ending is earned via setup versus arbitrary, a genuine structural craft measure.

decisions.name: Deliberate sentence rhythm
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether sentence rhythm purposefully embodies viewpoint/tension versus accidental choppiness.

decisions.name: Ending that resonates rather than merely resolves
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether the ending leaves resonant aftertaste versus mechanical closure, a genuine craft measure.

decisions.name: Late reveal reframes rather than cancels
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether a late reveal deepens meaning versus cheaply cancels stakes, a genuine plotting craft measure.

decisions.name: Fresh concrete specificity
decisions.audit_reason: Judges specificity and singularity of detail versus stock alternatives, a genuine craft dimension.

decisions.name: Conceit enacted rather than announced
decisions.audit_reason: Judges show-don't-tell execution of theme, a well-established literary craft standard.

decisions.name: Disciplined ambiguity
decisions.audit_reason: Distinguishes deliberate, evidence-bounded ambiguity from accidental confusion, a genuine craft judgment.

sign_contradiction_reaudit.reason: Editors do distinguish controlled, evidence-bounded ambiguity from muddle or over-explanation; the low pole names observable defects, so it is scoreable. Negative sign likely reflects community preference for explicit resolution.

decisions.name: Reciprocal relationships
decisions.audit_reason: Measures depth of character relationships vs flat props; core craft judgment about characterization quality.

decisions.name: Prompt-detail payoff
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether a planted detail is dramatically earned (Chekhov's gun), a genuine craft measure.

decisions.name: Controlled tonal modulation
decisions.audit_reason: Judges deliberate versus accidental tonal shifts; controlled tone is a genuine craft skill.

decisions.name: Closing self-promotion block naming the author's own subreddit
decisions.audit_reason: Counts a self-promotional sign-off block, pure platform furniture unrelated to the story itself.

decisions.name: Continuation and prior-context dependence
decisions.audit_reason: Counts continuation labels and links to prior installments -- a structural/serialization fingerprint, not quality.

decisions.name: Author's explicit self-deprecating hedge about experience or quality
decisions.audit_reason: Detects a meta-textual disclaimer about the author's experience, not evidence about the story's actual quality.

decisions.name: Immediate voice mode
decisions.audit_reason: Counts presence of first-person/dialogue opening cues regardless of execution -- a formulaic technique tally.

decisions.name: Fashionable subgenre trope vocabulary (LitRPG stats, dragon-rider tropes)
decisions.audit_reason: Flags currently-fashionable subgenre trope vocabulary (LitRPG, dragon-riders) -- a trend fingerprint, not quality.

decisions.name: Editorial polish signature
decisions.audit_reason: Tracks surface copyediting consistency (spelling/grammar/formatting), not substantive narrative quality.

decisions.name: Decorative markup and divider load
decisions.audit_reason: Counts decorative formatting (italics, dividers) -- surface presentation, not narrative substance.

decisions.name: Non-story furniture and editor markup debris inside the body
decisions.audit_reason: Counts moderation notices, markup debris, and formatting artifacts -- platform furniture, not craft.

decisions.name: Mean sentence-length variance
decisions.audit_reason: Pure sentence-length variance statistic; instruction explicitly ignores whether variation is purposeful.

decisions.name: Distinct-adjective type count
decisions.audit_reason: Counts distinct adjective vocabulary size; instruction explicitly ignores whether description is apt.

sign_band_note: two-sided noise-scaled band adopted for rounds 6+; 5 further criteria fell inside the null band and were NOT re-audited
